# Will your flock pay for its hay?

> Free sheep and goat farm profit calculator. Project your flock, lambs or kids sold, hay cost and profit year by year; see what weaning rate, hay price and market price do, plus break-even flock size. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
